title: Projectivity from simultaneous self-Ext and algebra-Ext vanishing
exact_target: For every finite-dimensional algebra A over a field and every finite-dimensional left A-module M, does $Ext_A^i(M,M\oplus A)=0$ for all integers $i>0$ imply that M is projective?
